name: Indo-Sri Lanka Free Trade Agreement (ISFTA)
key_benefits: Significant duty concessions for pharmaceutical exports. Indian medicines and pharmaceutical products exported to Sri Lanka can claim 100% duty exemption under ISFTA.

specific_regulations.pharmaceuticals: All medicines must be pre-registered with the Sri Lanka National Medicines Regulatory Authority (NMRA). An NMRA Import License is strictly required. A Certificate of Pharmaceutical Product (CPP) issued by the Indian CDSCO must accompany the ICEGATE Shipping Bill.
